text:
[LCDB.3.3.4] **`by:` declares the activation key, and where a
non-`logical` fact is bound it is required.** A rule header may carry one
`by:` modifier ([LCDB.5.1]). When it is written, the activation key **is**
what it names — an ordered tuple of `<binding>.<slot>` paths, or the single
global key `by: none` — for the `cooldown`, in place of
[LCDB.3.3.3]'s composition.

A rule that carries a rate modifier and binds, in a positive pattern, a fact of
any lifecycle other than `logical` must carry one, because no such fact has
identity slots ([LFAC.1.7.6]): omitting it is `DS_VALIDATE_RATE_KEY_REQUIRED`. A rule binding
only `logical` facts may omit it and takes [LCDB.3.3.3]'s key. A path naming
a binding the rule does not declare, or a slot the bound schema does not
have, is `DS_VALIDATE_RATE_KEY_BAD_PATH`.

**Why it is required rather than defaulted.** A `ttl` fact has no declared
identity ([LFAC.1.7.6]), and both available defaults are wrong in a way the
author cannot see. Every slot gives an event carrying a `ts`
or any other per-event value a tracker of its own, so the cooldown never
suppresses anything; that is [LCDB.3.3.1]'s churn failure, moved from
`mutable` slots to event payloads. No slots at all quietly makes the rule
single-windowed across every entity, which is the opposite of what
[LCDB.3.3.1] says rate control is for. The declaration is one line and it is
the only form that says which the author meant, which is the same reason a
series on a schema with no identity must name `by:` ([LSER.7.6.1]).

idris.name: Lcdb_3_2_1__cool
idris.note: LESS than the clause: the `by:` paths are the fixture lowering's slot reads in the written order and `by: none` the empty key; the two validation errors are the compiler's. Here the key is a function of the match.

idris.name: lcdb_3_3_4__pay_of_head
idris.note: A `by:` path to a payload slot of a ttl fact: the model's `fpay`, the code of the payload slots. A fixture.

idris.name: lcdb_3_3_4__ttl_by_suppresses
idris.note: The shape of logical/LCDB.3.3.4_ttl_by_suppresses: a ttl schema with no identity, the key a payload slot under `by:`; three facts pumped in turn at clock 0, the second carrying the first's key refused, the third its own key admitted. Executed.

idris.name: lcdb_3_3_4__ttl_thirty
idris.note: The 5 min TTL of logical/LCDB.3.3.4_ttl_by_suppresses in units of its 10 s window. A fixture.
